more_beautiful.reason: B's letter-spaced Kai title, red seal, brush-stroke underline, warm paper cards and seal-red button make a polished, cohesive page, while A looks plain, with a heavy black button, single characters left alone on the last line of both class cards, and a lopsided desktop layout.

less_generic.reason: A builds the class choice from 米字格 practice squares and draws a red circle around the chosen character, the way a calligraphy teacher marks a student's work, whereas B is a standard form of rounded cards whose calligraphy theme is mostly a seal and a brush-stroke decoration.

better_overall.reason: B suits seventy-year-olds on phones better, with larger text, the plain wording '下午 2 点到 4 点', a check step that shows the phone number as 3-4-4, and a clear '报名成功' with next steps, and it gives the school a password-protected list of sign-ups with a CSV download, so it is the safer page to publish despite A's more original idea.

A: The class choice is built from 米字格 practice squares (楷 / 行); picking a class draws a red circle around the character, like a teacher marking good work, and adds '已选', so the choice is clearly calligraphy and clearly selected.
Large text (20 px body, 24 px labels and inputs), controls 64 px tall, the whole card is tappable, and contrast is strong.
Honest about what is not known: it says up front that place, start date and payment will be sent by phone, and invents no facts.

Solid flow: a list of errors at the top plus errors beside each field, kind and specific wording ('现在是 10 位'), a network-failure message that says the entries are still there, a confirmation page with the details, a way to edit after submitting that replaces the earlier entry, and it still works without JavaScript.
The school gets a CSV file that opens in WPS or Excel without garbled Chinese, with repeat sign-ups (same phone, same class) merged.
B: Polished, warm look: a letter-spaced Kai title, a red seal, a brush-stroke underline, paper-toned cards and a red main button that matches the seal.
Very large text (20 px body; 26 px inputs, buttons and course details; 46 px title), controls 64 to 70 px tall, and the everyday wording '下午 2 点到 4 点'.

A guided flow: a check step showing the phone number as 138 1234 5678, the phone's back button handled, a smaller header on later steps so the button stays visible, '报名成功' with a green tick, a '接下来' section on what happens next, and '再帮别人报名' for signing up someone else.

Errors appear beside each field with friendly, specific wording, and the page jumps to the first wrong field; it tidies up names and phone numbers (full-width digits, +86, spaces, the · in minority names).

Good for the school: all wording sits in one config file, place and contact phone are optional and hidden when empty, there is a password-protected list of sign-ups grouped by class with tap-to-call numbers and a CSV download, and a dark mode.

A: Plain look: a flat cream page, a bold sans-serif title and a heavy black submit button; the calligraphy feel is limited to the small squares.
Chinese typesetting slips at 375 px: a single character sits alone on the last line of both class descriptions ('字', '书'), and '学校' is split across lines in the top note.
The class card leaves an empty gap under the class name, beside the square; on desktop the left column is mostly empty and the inputs and button are narrower than the cards.
'2:00–4:00' is less natural for older readers than '2 点到 4 点', and the heading '报名已提交' reassures less than '报名成功'.
No page for the school to view sign-ups; staff have to open the CSV on the server machine.
B: Apart from the seal and brush stroke it is a standard form of rounded cards with shadows that could pass for any template, so the calligraphy theme is only on the surface.
The extra check step adds a screen, though the request asked for simple operation.
The main page never says that place and start date are still to come, and it adds made-up details ('从握笔和基本笔画学起', '老师会打这个电话联系您', '我们会尽快打电话和您确认').
Someone who signs up again for the other class is told to '联系老师', but no contact is given; the centred privacy note splits '报名' across two lines.
